blocking_reasons: BM-01 strict dependency-chained invariant latency remains >= 1.5 ns on this host
acceptance.compile_scope: Local source-equivalent W1/W3 plus exact patched W5 mesh verifier compiled with gcc -O3 -march=native -Wall -Werror

diagnostic_steady_state_throughput_ns_pe.note: Eight independent checks may overlap; this is throughput only and cannot satisfy the latency gate.

BM-01.metric: dependency-chained invariant check latency proxy over a runtime-populated bank containing only transitions that satisfy Hamming/stage/efficiency invariants

BM-03.metric: Stage-10 fixed 60-byte BLAKE3 seed derivation us/roll

BM-04.claim_ceiling: RTT triangle consistency is a sanity heuristic, not a speed-of-light distance proof.
BM-04.metric: synthetic +/-50 ms jitter window plus median triangle-consistency heuristic

BM-06.claim_ceiling: Does not prove absence of transient copies in provider internals, registers, caches, swap, or physical remanence.
BM-06.metric: caller-owned designated key buffers are all-zero after aura_secure_bzero

blake3.scope: single-block <=64-byte BLAKE3; Stage-10 seed input is fixed at 60 bytes

methodology_correction.bm01_prior_issue: Prior harness used a per-iteration volatile sink and called its result throughput ns/check while the work order specifies latency; its 128-state bank also included an eta_eff_q16 bit flip that can intentionally fail the efficiency invariant.
methodology_correction.bm01_repair: Primary measurement is now dependency-chained. A separate unrolled throughput diagnostic is retained but cannot satisfy BM-01.
methodology_correction.bm04_prior_issue: Prior synthetic jitter samples covered only 0 to +20 ms rather than the requested +/-50 ms.
methodology_correction.bm04_repair: Symmetric -50 to +50 ms samples now exercise the full requested window.

requirements_interaction.resolution_from_W1: perform invariant check on transition control state, then derive/commit the 48-bit session seed slice as post-invariant Stage-10 rebase material

verification_boundary: Measured staging-host verification. Current W5 changes were not executed by GitHub CI; no production-network, CMVP-provider, physical-remanence, or independent side-channel claim is made.
